name: enhakkore
description: ENHAKKORE — Travel & Impact. A travel marketplace and social-impact platform.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @enhakkore/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @enhakkore/shared && npm run build --workspace @enhakkore/api && npm run build --workspace @enhakkore/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @enhakkore/shared && npm run build --workspace @enhakkore/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace @enhakkore/shared && npm run build --workspace @enhakkore/api
